headline: Nationwide Public Sector Strikes Ground Flights Across Belgium
summary: Flights and public transport services across Belgium were disrupted on Monday as trade unions launched strikes protesting proposed government austerity measures and budget cuts.
why: Public transport strikes can disrupt commerce and travel across the European Union administrative hub.

impacts.name: Belgium
impacts.why: Austerity strikes halted flight operations and transit services across Belgium.
